### Bruised Reeds
Author: Tim Keesee
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/bruised-reeds
Passage: Matthew 12:20-21
Points:
- Worldly leaders pursue power and influence, but Jesus advances His kingdom by ministering to the sick and marginalized.
- Christ’s gentle and quiet ministry fulfills Isaiah’s prophecy concerning God’s chosen Servant.
- People often present an image of strength while inwardly feeling bent and spiritually frail.
- Rather than discarding damaged reeds or extinguishing flickering flames, Jesus treats struggling believers with tender care.
- God deliberately chooses what is weak and unimpressive to display the greatness of His saving grace.

### Bruised Reed Ministry
Author: Darryl Dash
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/straight-paths/bruised-reed-ministry/
Passage: Matthew 12:20
Points:
- Many who come to church are spiritually exhausted, wounded, and burdened by personal crisis.
- Earthly powers tend to discard the vulnerable, whereas Jesus quietly welcomes and restores them.
- Christ fulfills ancient prophecy by refusing to snap bent reeds or snuff out dimly burning wicks.
- God routinely bypasses the self-sufficient to build His church through broken and unlikely people.
- Christian ministry faithfully represents Christ when it embraces and nurtures those who feel like misfits.
